title: Solar Adoption by Mandates
title_zh: 强制要求下的太阳能采用：DP21808
title_primary: 强制要求下的太阳能采用：DP21808
title_secondary: Solar Adoption by Mandates
authors: Stefano Carattini, Wade Davis, Béla Figge, Anton Heimerdinger
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Solar mandates are spreading rapidly. We leverage California’s frontrunner experience to examine their economics. First, we parameterize an engineering model to estimate private payoffs from solar adoption in residential new construction. Second, we test for a “solar gap” by comparing payoffs with observed adoption. Although estimated payoffs are generally positive, adoption varies widely. Most buildings do not adopt solar despite positive estimated payoffs, which explain little of the variation in adoption decisions. Third, we evaluate San Francisco’s citywide and California’s statewide mandates. Both mandates increased solar adoption considerably.
abstract_zh: 太阳能强制令正在迅速普及。我们利用加利福尼亚州的先行者经验来考察其经济效应。首先，我们对一个工程模型进行参数化，以估算住宅新建项目中采用太阳能的私人回报。其次，通过比较回报与实际采用情况，我们检验是否存在“太阳能缺口”。尽管估算的回报普遍为正，但采用情况差异显著。多数建筑即便估算回报为正也未采用太阳能，而这些回报对采用决策差异的解释力有限。第三，我们评估了旧金山市全市及加利福尼亚州全州的强制令。两项强制令均显著提升了太阳能的采用率。

title: Alternative Scenarios at the Federal Reserve from 1968 to 2020: Data, Interpretation, and Evaluation
title_zh: 1968年至2020年美联储的替代情景：数据、解释与评估
title_primary: 1968年至2020年美联储的替代情景：数据、解释与评估
title_secondary: Alternative Scenarios at the Federal Reserve from 1968 to 2020: Data, Interpretation, and Evaluation
authors: Edward Herbst, Scott Konzem, Cristina Scofield
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We comprehensively document 1,265 Federal Reserve staff alternative scenarios presented to the Federal Open Market Committee in publicly released materials from 1968 to 2020. Scenarios grew in frequency and sophistication, typically spanning a range of outcomes around the baseline. We construct a taxonomy with six categories: aggregate demand, aggregate supply, external risks, financial conditions, fiscal policy, and expectation shifts. Staff qualitative risk assessments complemented the scenario composition. Comparing scenario forecasts to realized outcomes, the most accurate scenarios often anticipated major macroeconomic developments even when magnitudes were missed, revealing the value and limits of scenario analysis for central bank risk management.
abstract_zh: 我们系统梳理了1968年至2020年间美联储工作人员在公开材料中向联邦公开市场委员会提交的1,265份替代情景分析。这些情景在频率和复杂性上持续提升，通常围绕基准预测构建一系列可能结果。我们构建了包含六大类别的分类体系：总需求、总供给、外部风险、金融条件、财政政策及预期转变。工作人员定性风险评估与情景构成形成互补。通过将情景预测与实际结果对比发现，即便在数值预测存在偏差时，最准确的情景往往仍能预判重大宏观经济走势，这揭示了情景分析在中央银行风险管理中的价值与局限性。

title: DP11 The Effects of American Policies - A New Classical Interpretation
title_zh: 美国政策的影响——一种新古典主义解释
title_primary: 美国政策的影响——一种新古典主义解释
title_secondary: DP11 The Effects of American Policies - A New Classical Interpretation
authors: Patrick Minford
official: 官方在线 1984-04-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The world economy is modelled by linking nine small country models of the 'new classical' type, and adding three blocs of trade equations to cover the smaller economies. The model (like the Liverpool Model of the United Kingdom) assumes rational expectations and market clearing (there are union and non-union sectors in the labour market). These assumptions distinguish it from available multi-country models such as Project Link, which tend to be very large and preserve a traditional Keynesian approach. Policy simulations show that bond-financed United States deficits generate approximately 100 percent 'crowding out' through higher interest rates, while United States monetary policy is very potent (a 1 percent once-for-all rise in the money supply raises world GNP by 0.8 percent in year 1). Recent world experience is argued to be consistent with these results. The large United States deficits have not been 'stimulatory' but have raised world real interest rates substantially. The United States monetary contraction in 1980-81 and expansion in late 1982 have been the major cause of the latest world business cycle. The model also indicates that, even though theoretically possible, international 'fine-tuning' is unnecessary as the model is fairly rapidly self-stabilising. Planned 'locomotive' policies - i.e., rises in budget deficits and money growth - will have their principal effect on inflationary expectations. Predictability of policy is clearly desirable. At the 'micro' country level, it would pay EEC governments to borrow less when United States deficits have pushed world interest rates up; this would ease pressure on the world capital market.
abstract_zh: 世界经济模型通过连接九个“新古典”类型的小国模型，并加入三个贸易方程板块以覆盖较小经济体构建而成。该模型（如同英国利物浦模型）假设理性预期和市场出清（劳动力市场存在工会与非工会部门）。这些假设使其区别于现有的大型多国模型（如“连接计划”模型），后者通常规模庞大且延续传统凯恩斯主义方法。政策模拟表明：债券融资的美国赤字通过推高利率产生约100%的“挤出效应”，而美国货币政策效果显著（货币供应量一次性增加1%将使第一年世界GNP增长0.8%）。近期世界经济经验与这些结果一致——美国巨额赤字并未产生“刺激效应”，反而大幅推高了全球实际利率。1980-81年的货币紧缩与1982年末的扩张，已成为本轮世界经济周期的主要成因。模型同时显示，尽管理论上存在国际“微调”可能，但由于模型具有较快的自我稳定机制，此类操作并无必要。计划中的“火车头”政策（即增加预算赤字与货币增长）将主要影响通胀预期，政策可预测性显然至关重要。在微观国家层面，当美国赤字推高全球利率时，欧共体各国政府减少借贷将是有利的——这有助于缓解世界资本市场的压力。

title: From policy to valuation: how voluntary environmental regulation drives corporate value
title_zh: 从政策到估值：自愿性环境规制如何驱动企业价值
title_primary: 从政策到估值：自愿性环境规制如何驱动企业价值
title_secondary: From policy to valuation: how voluntary environmental regulation drives corporate value
authors: Yuhao Liu, Xinze Li, Yawei Sun, Yurui Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Firms navigating the transition towards sustainable manufacturing face a critical strategic question: Can voluntary environmental regulation (VER) reconcile the tension between environmental compliance and market performance? Using Chinese A-share data from 2008 to 2024, this study treats the Green Factory Certification (GFC) Program as a quasi-natural experiment to examine the impact of VER on corporate market value. The results show that GFC significantly increases corporate market value. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy mainly boosts market value through two paths: promoting green innovation and attracting green investors. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that policy benefits are more pronounced in labour-intensive, non-state-owned, non-heavy-polluting enterprises and in regions characterized by stringent environmental regulation and higher levels of economic development.
abstract_zh: 在向可持续制造转型的过程中，企业面临一个关键的战略问题：自愿性环境规制能否调和环境合规与市场绩效之间的张力？本研究利用2008至2024年中国A股数据，将绿色工厂认证计划视为准自然实验，考察自愿性环境规制对企业市场价值的影响。结果表明，绿色工厂认证显著提升了企业市场价值。机制分析显示，该政策主要通过两条路径提升市场价值：促进绿色创新和吸引绿色投资者。异质性分析表明，政策收益在劳动密集型、非国有、非重污染企业以及环境规制严格、经济发展水平较高的地区更为显著。

title: Inferring conduct to guide strategic trade policy
title_zh: 推断行为以指导战略贸易政策
title_primary: 推断行为以指导战略贸易政策
title_secondary: Inferring conduct to guide strategic trade policy
authors: Eileen (Ce) Bian, Keith Head, Scott Orr
official: 官方在线 2026-07-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In oligopoly market structures, optimal trade policies depend on the conduct of competing firms. Whether firms compete with prices or quantities as the strategic variables has a major quantitative and, sometimes, qualitative impact on the design of optimal trade policies. Conduct is not directly observable, but we develop an econometric method to infer it from data on prices, quantities, and a cost shifter such as tariffs. We apply the method to the widely used case of a constant elasticity of substitution demand and ad valorem tariffs. Using simulations, we show how policy makers could infer conduct from estimation and thereby generate domestic welfare gains from strategic trade policy when conduct is ex ante unknown. Several caveats from the literature remain important, but our method mitigates concerns over imperfect information on conduct.
abstract_zh: 在寡头市场结构中，最优贸易政策取决于竞争企业的行为模式。企业是以价格还是产量作为战略变量进行竞争，对最优贸易政策的设计会产生重大的数量影响，有时甚至会产生质的影响。行为模式无法直接观测，但我们开发了一种计量经济学方法，通过价格、产量以及关税等成本变动因素的数据来推断企业行为。我们将该方法应用于广泛使用的恒定替代弹性需求与从价关税案例。通过模拟分析，我们展示了政策制定者如何通过估计推断企业行为，从而在行为模式事先未知的情况下，通过战略性贸易政策实现国内福利提升。文献中的若干重要警示仍需关注，但我们的方法缓解了对行为模式信息不完全的担忧。

title: 亲清政商关系与民营部门雇员晋升：一项准自然实验研究
title_zh: 亲清政商关系与民营部门雇员晋升：一项准自然实验研究
title_primary: 亲清政商关系与民营部门雇员晋升：一项准自然实验研究
authors: 孙文凯, 刘宏彦, 唐思远
official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 中央八项规定自上而下重塑了政商交往方式,对整饬政治风气和构建优良社会风尚具有重要意义。本文从微观视角出发,探究中央八项规定对民营部门善饮酒者职业发展的影响。研究发现,八项规定显著降低了民营部门善饮酒者的职业晋升概率。进一步研究表明,八项规定规范了政商间非正式沟通渠道,削弱了饮酒技能的市场回报。政策效应在酒桌文化浓、政府补助依赖度高、市场化程度高的区域更加显著。本研究为理解制度环境对人力资本作用的影响提供了微观证据,证实了制度环境变化会使特定技能的市场价值因供需关系改变而重新定价。

title: Learning in the Marriage Market: The Economics of Dating
title_zh: 婚姻市场中的学习：约会的经济学
title_primary: 婚姻市场中的学习：约会的经济学
title_secondary: Learning in the Marriage Market: The Economics of Dating
authors: Antler, Yair, Bird, Daniel, Fershtman, Daniel
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops a search-and-matching model where potential partners can learn about their compatibility as a couple by spending time together (interpreted as dating). We show that a steady-state equilibrium exists and characterize its induced dating patterns. In equilibrium, highly attractive individuals are more selective. We derive conditions under which equilibria induce positive assortative matching, and show that even when these conditions hold, the socially optimal outcome can exhibit negative assortative matching. Finally, the framework is applied to study the effect of recent advances in search technologies on dating patterns and the connection between dating and interracial segregation.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个搜索匹配模型，其中潜在伴侣可通过共度时光（即约会）来了解彼此作为情侣的兼容性。我们证明了稳态均衡的存在性，并刻画了其诱发的约会模式特征。在均衡状态下，高吸引力个体更具选择性。我们推导出均衡产生正向选型匹配的条件，并证明即使这些条件成立，社会最优结果仍可能呈现负向选型匹配。最后，该框架被应用于研究搜索技术的最新进展对约会模式的影响，以及约会与种族隔离现象之间的关联。

title: The Establishment of Pilot Free Trade Zones and Carbon Emissions
title_zh: 自贸试验区设立与碳排放
title_primary: 自贸试验区设立与碳排放
title_secondary: The Establishment of Pilot Free Trade Zones and Carbon Emissions
authors: Jie Xing, Qingfang Yao, Mingyi Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study evaluates the impact of the Pilot Free Trade Zones (PFTZs) on the carbon emissions of enterprises located within the zones. By manually identifying PFTZs’ boundaries and employing a spatial regression discontinuity (SRD) design, we find that the establishment of the PFTZs significantly reduces the carbon emission intensity of enterprises within the zones. This conclusion remains valid across a series of robustness tests. Mechanism analysis reveals that the PFTZs drives emission reductions by intensifying market competition, stimulating green technology innovation, and alleviating financing constraints. Furthermore, heterogeneity analyses indicate that these effects are more pronounced in heavily polluting industries, technology-intensive enterprises, non-state-owned enterprises, and areas with a larger scale of construction. This study provides a vital theoretical basis for China’s green and high-quality development strategies in the current context of carbon reduction.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了自由贸易试验区（PFTZs）对区内企业碳排放的影响。通过手动识别自贸区边界并采用空间断点回归（SRD）设计，我们发现自贸区的设立显著降低了区内企业的碳排放强度。该结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，自贸区通过加剧市场竞争、激发绿色技术创新以及缓解融资约束来推动减排。此外，异质性分析显示，这些效应在重污染行业、技术密集型企业、非国有企业以及建设规模较大的区域更为显著。本研究为当前碳减排背景下中国绿色高质量发展战略提供了重要的理论依据。

abstract: Moretti (2021) reports a positive elasticity between technology cluster size and patenting, and uses an event study and instrumental variables regressions to justify a causal interpretation. The event study does not use the variation generated by inventors moving across cities, and the instrument is constructed incorrectly due to a coding error. I run a corrected event study and fix the coding error, and find null effects. The reported elasticity may not be causal. (JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32)
abstract_zh: Moretti（2021）报告了技术集群规模与专利申请之间的正向弹性，并通过事件研究和工具变量回归论证了因果解释。该事件研究未利用发明人在城市间流动产生的变异，且由于编码错误导致工具变量构建有误。我重新进行了修正的事件研究并纠正了编码错误，发现效应为零。其报告的弹性可能不具有因果性。（JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32）

title: Demographic Divergence: The Legacy of the Opioid Epidemic
title_zh: 人口分化：阿片类药物危机的遗留影响
title_primary: 人口分化：阿片类药物危机的遗留影响
title_secondary: Demographic Divergence: The Legacy of the Opioid Epidemic
authors: Carolina Arteaga, Victoria Barone, Stephen Claassen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how the opioid epidemic shaped local population dynamics in the United States. Exploiting variation in exposure that stems from Purdue Pharma's targeted marketing of OxyContin to high-cancer-mortality areas, we find that more exposed commuting zones experienced lower population growth. By 2020, a one-standard-deviation increase in exposure reduced population growth among individuals aged 18 to 64 by 2.4 percentage points. Direct mortality from drug-induced deaths made only a limited contribution to these changes. Instead, population losses were primarily driven by migratory responses: exposure increased out-migration rates, especially among college-educated individuals. These responses are consistent with the opioid epidemic operating as a disamenity shock, deteriorating local quality of life. Working in the opposite direction, we also document a rise in fertility rates that, by 2020, partially counteracts these population losses. Our findings show that the opioid epidemic reshaped local demographic composition and contributed to the long-run divergence in population dynamics across U.S. commuting zones.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了阿片类药物危机如何塑造美国地方人口动态。利用普渡制药公司针对高癌症死亡率地区定向营销奥施康定所导致的暴露程度差异，我们发现暴露程度更高的通勤区人口增长率更低。截至2020年，暴露程度每增加一个标准差，18至64岁人群的人口增长率下降2.4个百分点。药物致死导致的直接死亡率对这些变化的贡献有限。相反，人口损失主要由迁移响应驱动：暴露程度提高了迁出率，尤其是在受过大学教育的群体中。这些响应与阿片类药物危机作为负外部性冲击、恶化地方生活质量的机制一致。作为反向作用，我们还发现生育率上升，到2020年部分抵消了这些人口损失。我们的研究结果表明，阿片类药物危机重塑了地方人口结构，并加剧了美国各通勤区人口动态的长期分化。

title: Blended finance
title_zh: 混合融资
title_primary: 混合融资
title_secondary: Blended finance
authors: Caroline Flammer, Thomas Giroux, Geoffrey M. Heal
official: Crossref 元数据日期 September  · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Blended finance—the use of public and philanthropic funding to crowd in private capital—has emerged as a potential tool for financing sustainable development. Yet little is known about the design of blended finance contracts. We develop a conceptual framework in which development finance institutions (DFIs) allocate concessional capital across projects to maximize societal impact while crowding in private investors. Our framework highlights a trade-off between sustainability impact and the amount of concessionality required to make projects commercially viable and characterizes how DFIs optimally combine different instruments, including concessional debt, junior equity tranches, and risk management facilities. We then provide empirical evidence on blended finance using deal-level data from a major DFI. Consistent with our conceptual framework, projects with higher anticipated sustainability impact receive greater concessionality. Moreover, concessionality is higher in countries with greater political risk and information asymmetries, and these projects are more likely to include risk management provisions. Our findings provide new evidence on how DFIs deploy catalytic capital to mobilize private investment in sustainable development.

title: Payment data, information disclosure, and privacy
title_zh: 支付数据、信息披露与隐私
title_primary: 支付数据、信息披露与隐私
title_secondary: Payment data, information disclosure, and privacy
authors: Kee-Youn Kang, Zijian Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to examine the welfare implications of aggregate-demand information derived from payment data. The disclosure of such information tends to improve aggregate welfare when interest rates are low but may reduce welfare when rates are high. If a central bank controls information disclosure, it can craft noisy messages that encourage investment and benefit welfare through a form of Bayesian persuasion. If the information is instead produced by private banks and traded in a competitive market, excessive information production may happen. Finally, privacy concerns may dissuade some consumers from using digital payments, thereby decreasing the precision of aggregate-demand information, but it need not reduce welfare.

title: Bank capital and the minimum corporate tax

authors: Alessandro Chiari
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines whether the Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax reduces bank profitability and regulatory capital, and for which banks the effects are strongest. We use a quarterly exposure-based difference-in-differences design around 2024Q1, where treatment intensity is defined by pre-2024 low-tax exposure among in-scope banks. The analysis uses a quarterly bank-level panel for 2014–2024 and exploits predetermined cross-sectional heterogeneity in low-tax exposure while controlling for bank and quarter fixed effects. The headline estimates show that post-2024 profitability and capital buffers decline more for high-exposure banks: profit after tax falls by about 2.2 basis points of assets per quarter and Tier 1 buffers by about 0.09 percentage points in the baseline specification. Higher low-tax exposure is not interpreted as vulnerability per se. The downside channel is concentrated where high pre-reform low-tax exposure coincides with limited initial capital headroom: event-study, placebo, matched-sample, and split-sample evidence all point to larger post-2024 capital-buffer compression for thin-buffer banks. Overall, the results indicate modest average effects but meaningful tail risk for banks that combine high minimum-tax exposure with thin initial capital buffers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了支柱二全球最低税是否降低了银行盈利能力和监管资本，以及哪些银行受到的影响最为显著。我们采用基于季度暴露水平的双重差分设计，以2024年第一季度为政策节点，将受覆盖银行在2024年前的低税暴露程度定义为处理强度。分析基于2014-2024年银行层面季度面板数据，利用预先确定的低税暴露截面异质性，同时控制银行和季度固定效应。主要估计结果显示，2024年后高暴露银行的盈利能力和资本缓冲下降幅度更大：在基准设定中，税后利润每季度下降约2.2个基点（以资产计），一级资本缓冲下降约0.09个百分点。较高的低税暴露本身并不被解读为脆弱性。其负面传导渠道集中于改革前低税暴露较高且初始资本缓冲空间有限的银行：事件研究、安慰剂检验、匹配样本和分样本证据均表明，资本缓冲薄弱的银行在2024年后资本缓冲压缩幅度更大。总体而言，研究结果表明平均效应温和，但对于初始资本缓冲薄弱且面临较高最低税暴露的银行而言，存在显著的尾部风险。

title: Premium procurement channel access and farm-gate prices: evidence from rice farmers in China
title_zh: 优质采购渠道准入与农场交货价格：来自中国稻农的证据
title_primary: 优质采购渠道准入与农场交货价格：来自中国稻农的证据
title_secondary: Premium procurement channel access and farm-gate prices: evidence from rice farmers in China
authors: Junjie Li, Jianping Li, Qin Xiao, Haixia Wu, Di Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 August 202 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines not only whether paddy procurement channels are associated with price differences in China, but also which farmers are able to capture the gains from the premium channel. Using farm-level panel data, we classify farmers’ paddy sales into four procurement-channel categories: the intermediary channel, the milling channel, the grain depot channel, and multi-channel sales. We estimate net farm-gate paddy price differentials using household fixed-effects models, assess heterogeneity by farm size, rice-income dependence, and adoption of high-quality varieties, and analyze access to the empirically identified premium channel using binary logit and fixed-effects linear probability models. We find that only the milling channel is consistently associated with a price premium. In the baseline specification, selling through the milling channel is associated with net farm-gate paddy prices about 4.5% higher than those received through the intermediary channel. The premium is larger for large-scale farmers, households less reliant on rice income, and growers of high-quality varieties. Medium-scale farmers emerge as the “missing middle”: they are less likely to access the premium channel and least likely to move into it over time. Access to formal market information is robustly associated with premium-channel access, while storage capacity strengthens the price premium associated with the milling channel. Overall, the results suggest that the gains from procurement-channel upgrading are unevenly distributed and depend crucially on who can reach the premium channel and convert that access into realized price gains.

title: Formation of teams in contests: tradeoffs between inter- and intra-team inequalities
title_zh: 竞赛中团队的形成：团队间与团队内不平等的权衡
title_primary: 竞赛中团队的形成：团队间与团队内不平等的权衡
title_secondary: Formation of teams in contests: tradeoffs between inter- and intra-team inequalities
authors: Hideo Konishi, Chen-Yu Pan, Dimitar Simeonov
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider a team contest in which players make efforts to compete with other teams for a prize, and players of the winning team divide the prize according to a prize-sharing rule. Assuming that players differ in their abilities and their abilities are observable, we analyze which team structure realizes by allowing players to move across teams. A team structure is stable if there is no successful head-hunting opportunity. We show that if all teams employ the egalitarian sharing rule, then the complete sorting of players according to their abilities occurs, and inter-team inequality becomes the largest. In contrast, if all teams employ a substantially unequal sharing rule, there is a stable team structure with a small inter-team inequality and a large intra-team inequality. This result illustrates a trade-off between intra-team inequality and inter-team inequality in forming teams.

title: Beyond the headlines: the intangible costs of terrorism
title_zh: 标题之外：恐怖主义的无形代价
title_primary: 标题之外：恐怖主义的无形代价
title_secondary: Beyond the headlines: the intangible costs of terrorism
authors: Harry Pickard, Vincenzo Bove, Georgios Efthyvoulou
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Do terrorist attacks affect life satisfaction and mental health? To explore this question, we analyse data on all casualty-causing terrorist incidents in Great Britain from 1992 to 2020, and combine this information with individual-level data from the British Household Panel Survey and the UK Household Longitudinal Study over the same period. To get as close as possible to a causal interpretation, we exploit variation within individuals, net of potential attack-specific and aggregate temporal factors, and report an array of different specifications and robustness tests. Our analysis reveals that geographic proximity to terrorist attacks decreases life satisfaction, particularly when the incidents occurred within the month before the interview. We also find that individuals with pre-existing mental vulnerabilities exhibit higher distress levels following a recent terrorism shock.

title: The bread of Toledo: Prices and political economy, 1535–1800
title_zh: 托莱多的面包：价格与政治经济学，1535–1800
title_primary: 托莱多的面包：价格与政治经济学，1535–1800
title_secondary: The bread of Toledo: Prices and political economy, 1535–1800
authors: Mauricio Drelichman, David González Agudo
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the market for common white bread in the city of Toledo through a new 266‐year‐long series of bread prices, obtained from the cash purchases and wholesale bread‐for‐wheat contracts of large institutions. Our data are strongly consistent with fragmentary evidence on retail price regulation, as well as with shorter series from other regional markets, suggesting they can be considered representative of consumer bread costs for a broad area of New Castile. We show that, in different periods, Toledo's bread prices were substantially lower than two common series used in the comparative literature. We also explore the role of urban institutions in stabilizing prices. We econometrically demonstrate that Toledo's wheat price fluctuations were consistent with a 1‐year storage cycle, suggesting that urban supply management systems were effective at smoothing the extreme fluctuations in early modern harvest yields. The amount of bread in a respectability basket was generally within reach of urban wage earners up to 1750. Resurgent inflation and the breakdown in regulatory institutions resulted in a marked deterioration in the affordability of bread in the second half of the eighteenth century.
abstract_zh: 本文通过大型机构现金采购和面包换小麦批发合同，构建了长达266年的托莱多市普通白面包价格序列。该数据与零售价格管制的零散证据及其他区域市场的短序列高度吻合，表明其可代表新卡斯蒂利亚广大地区消费者面包成本。研究发现，在不同时期，托莱多的面包价格显著低于比较文献中常用的两种序列。我们还探讨了城市机构在稳定价格中的作用。计量分析表明，托莱多小麦价格波动符合一年期储存周期规律，说明城市供应管理系统有效平抑了近代早期收成产量的极端波动。直至1750年，城市工薪阶层基本能负担体面生活所需的面包量。但18世纪下半叶，通胀回升与监管体系瓦解导致面包可负担性显著恶化。

title: From housing gains to pension losses: Micro-macro integration to reveal wealth inequality dynamics in Chile
title_zh: 从住房收益到养老金损失：微观-宏观整合揭示智利财富不平等动态
title_primary: 从住房收益到养老金损失：微观-宏观整合揭示智利财富不平等动态
title_secondary: From housing gains to pension losses: Micro-macro integration to reveal wealth inequality dynamics in Chile
authors: Bastián Castro Nofal, Ignacio Flores, Pablo Gutiérrez Cubillos
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the levels and dynamics of wealth inequality in Chile between 2007 and 2021, in a context where the private pension system is mandatory and government housing policies are centered on private ownership. We focus on two major macroeconomic events: the sharp increase in housing prices following the introduction of a value-added tax on new dwellings in 2016 and the large-scale liquidation of pension assets through early withdrawals during the recent pandemic. To do so, we construct a micro–macro consistent wealth distribution by extending existing methodologies to integrate administrative pension fund balances into household wealth surveys using machine learning techniques. Our results reveal pronounced wealth concentration: the top 1% hold roughly one-third of total private wealth—levels comparable to those observed in the United States—driven by their disproportionate ownership of financial assets. By contrast, the bottom 50% hold 7–9%, primarily through housing and pension assets, shares that exceed those reported in most European countries. We also document a modest decline in wealth inequality over the period, particularly after 2016. A counterfactual analysis suggests that this decline reflects the interaction of two opposing forces: housing appreciation, which predominantly benefited the bottom 90% of households, and pension withdrawals, which reduced wealth across the distribution while relatively increasing inequality. Our findings on levels, trends, and counterfactuals are robust across alternative methodological specifications.

title: Urban Forests: Environmental Health Values and Risks
title_zh: 城市森林：环境健康价值与风险
title_primary: 城市森林：环境健康价值与风险
title_secondary: Urban Forests: Environmental Health Values and Risks
authors: Jianwei Xing, Zhiren Hu, Fan Xia, Jintao Xu, Eric Yongchen Zou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban forests are ubiquitous, yet their impacts and values remain largely unknown. We study a massive urban afforestation policy in Beijing that planted 1/3 of a million acres of greenery in less than a decade. We conduct a remote-sensing audit of the program, finding that it contributes to a substantial greening up of the city. This causes significant downwind air quality improvement, reducing average PM2.5 concentration at city population hubs by 4.2%. Rapid vegetation growth unexpectedly led to a 7.4% increase in pollen exposure. Analysis of medical claims data shows that increased aeroallergens triggered emergency room visits, mirroring pollution effects though much less severe. Monetized net health benefits of the program amount to 1.5% of the city’s GDP. Urban forests are only partially capitalized in housing values, with buyers mainly appreciating proximity to green spaces but not the air quality improvements they bring.
abstract_zh: 城市森林无处不在，但其影响和价值在很大程度上仍不为人知。我们研究了北京一项大规模的城市造林政策，该政策在不到十年内种植了33万英亩的绿地。通过对该项目的遥感审计，我们发现它显著提升了城市的绿化水平。这带来了显著的下风向空气质量改善，使城市人口聚集区的平均PM2.5浓度降低了4.2%。然而，植被的快速生长意外导致花粉暴露量增加了7.4%。对医疗索赔数据的分析显示，空气过敏原的增加引发了急诊就诊，其影响与污染类似，但严重程度远低于污染。该政策的货币化净健康效益相当于该市GDP的1.5%。城市森林仅部分资本化于住房价值中，购房者主要看重靠近绿地的便利性，而非其带来的空气质量改善。

title: The case for lobbying transparency
title_zh: 游说透明化的理由
title_primary: 游说透明化的理由
title_secondary: The case for lobbying transparency
authors: Antoine Zerbini
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Lobbying transparency regulations are hailed as a potential solution to concerns about the excessive influence of special interest groups (SIGs) over policymaking. I study how these regulations shape strategic interactions between voters, politicians and SIGs. By clarifying the process through which a policy was implemented, lobbying transparency helps voters hold politicians accountable and control the influence of SIGs. Ex-post, conditional on access, SIGs prefer to operate without lobbying transparency. Ex-ante, they may benefit from lobbying transparency because it redirects the voters’ blame towards politicians. However, lobbying transparency standards may ultimately hurt the electoral prospects of politicians and thus risk never being implemented, potentially explaining why voters’ demand for it remains unanswered.

title: Online platform entry and food safety risk: Evidence from the Chinese restaurant industry
title_zh: 在线平台进入与食品安全风险：来自中国餐饮业的证据
title_primary: 在线平台进入与食品安全风险：来自中国餐饮业的证据
title_secondary: Online platform entry and food safety risk: Evidence from the Chinese restaurant industry
authors: Baojie Ma, Yuqing Zheng, Shaosheng Jin, Bin Lyu
official: 官方在线 2026-02-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The online food delivery (OFD) industry has witnessed substantial global expansion. In this study, we examine how OFD platforms in China affect the food safety conditions of restaurants. Given the difficulty quantifying food safety, we first propose a machine learning approach to construct a restaurant‐specific food safety risk indicator based on online customer reviews. The approach features high‐frequency continuous measurements with complete geographic coverage. We also conducted an event study and found that the food safety risk in restaurants decreased significantly in response to OFD platforms, with the effects concentrated in the five quarters including the entry period. Our mechanism analysis suggests that this improvement might come from extended market information, strengthened market competition, and heightened supervision and regulation. The impact is also more pronounced for chain restaurants, restaurants that are relatively popular and expensive, and restaurants offering low‐risk food items.
